tools.name: search
tools.description: Search venues, travel destinations and places inside destinations by name or keyword. Returns results of id, title and url; pass an id to fetch for the full page. For filters use search_venues, search_menus or destination_listings.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read the full page for one search result id as Markdown text, with its citable url. Ids look like "venue:acme-bistro", "destination:los-cabos" or "listing:los-cabos:1234".

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Find restaurants and bars by city, cuisine, opening time or features. Filters are HARD, prefer_* and avoid are SOFT (rank only), and query is ONE keyword. Each result has slug, capabilities, open_now and distance_km; a place inside a destination is not here, use destination_listings.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities that have published restaurants and bars. Travel destinations such as Los Cabos are not cities here; read one with destination_overview.

tools.name: search_menus
tools.description: Find dishes across all venues by text, city, dietary tags or allergens to avoid. Each item is tagged with its venue, so one call compares venues; for one named venue use venue_menu.

tools.name: venue_profile
tools.description: Get a venue's hours, address, map, phone, booking and links by name or slug, e.g. venue="Acme Bistro". It also holds cuisine, attributes, menu_summary and capabilities (the other venue_* tools that answer for it); hours_summary is ready to quote.

tools.name: venue_menu
tools.description: Find dishes at a named venue, e.g. venue="Acme Bistro", dietary_tags=["vegan"], allergens=["milk"]. Filter by text, tags, allergens or max_price; unfiltered, item lists its dietary tags, example dishes and allergen counts. If not available, check the capabilities venue_profile lists; the venue may n

tools.name: venue_faq
tools.description: Answer a question about a named venue from its published FAQs; omit query to read them all. If not available, check the capabilities venue_profile lists; the venue may not publish this.

tools.name: venue_events
tools.description: Find what is on at a named venue: dated events from its local today onwards. Filter by exact event_type if you know it. If not available, check the capabilities venue_profile lists; the venue may not publish this.

tools.name: destination_overview
tools.description: One call answers what a destination offers and what's on: counts, a few places, next events and guide topics. It counts offers, seasonality and FAQs too, and names the categories and areas listings, events and offers filter by. Drill in with destination_listings / destination_events only if preview.

tools.name: destination_listings
tools.description: Find places to stay, eat and visit in a named destination by text, category, area or tags. Every query word matches, in any order; each business appears once (also_listed_as) with a snippet and map_url, so call it again with listing_id for the full text. An unknown filter value's reason lists the va

tools.name: destination_events
tools.description: Find what is on in a named destination: events from today onwards. A recurring event's dates are its series span, so read its recurrence. Offer booking_url when present; cite canonical_url, the destination's page.

tools.name: destination_guide
tools.description: Read a named destination's travel guides: weather, getting here, transport, entry requirements, safety and more. Pass topic (from destination_overview guide_topics) to read one subject; page with cursor.

tools.name: destination_faq
tools.description: Answer a question about a named destination from its published FAQs; omit query to read them all.

tools.name: destination_offers
tools.description: Find a named destination's current deals and packages, with the partner booking link. Only offers valid on valid_on (today by default) are returned. Offer booking_url when present; cite canonical_url, the destination's page.

tools.name: destination_seasonality
tools.description: Get a named destination's best time to visit, weather and wildlife seasons (e.g. whale watching), month by month.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

evidence.snippet: search

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

evidence.snippet: fetch

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: venue_menu, venue_faq, venue_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: venue_menu, venue_faq, venue_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_venues" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search published venues by name or description, optionally filtered by city, cuisine, price band, neighbourhood, whether the venue takes reservations, proximity (near a lat/long within a radius, nearest first) and opening hours (open on a given day/time, or open now) — all HARD filters that exclude " → after: "Find restaurants and bars by city, cuisine, opening time or features. Filters are HARD, prefer_* and avoid are SOFT (rank only), and query is ONE keyword. Each result has slug, capabilities, open_now and distance_km; a place inside a destination is not here, use destination_listings."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
